releases.name: Swift Quit v1.5
releases.body:
- Removed unnecessary options
- Code cleanup
- Add ability to hide menubar
- Changed settings shortcut and label
- Fix issue with Launch on Login option

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/onebadidea/swiftquit/compare/v1.4...v1.5

releases.name: Swift Quit v1.4
releases.body:
- Added check for app.isFinishedLaunching
- Make Finder and Spotlight excluded by default

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/onebadidea/swiftquit/compare/v1.3...v1.4

releases.name: Swift Quit v1.3
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* fixes #3: quit apps after 2 seconds delay by @incanus in https://github.com/onebadidea/swiftquit/pull/9
* fixes #6: ignore "window close" events when they mean tabs by @incanus in https://github.com/onebadidea/swiftquit/pull/8
* Add option to only quit list of user selected apps Issue #12 by @logwet in https://github.com/onebadidea/swiftquit/pull/15

## New Contributors
* @incanus made their first contribution in https://github.com/onebadidea/swiftquit/pull/9
* @logwet made their first contribution in https://github.com/onebadidea/swiftquit/pull/15

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/onebadidea/swiftquit/commits/v1.3
